children: Polymarket’s submarket for the New York Yankees vs. Arizona Diamondbacks game, “New York Yankees O/U 6.5,” saw the “Over” option’s win probability swing sharply from 43% one hour earlier to 22% at present, a 21-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move may reflect the impact of a sudden news event.

title: Polymarket Yankees O/U 6.5 Over Odds Drop to 22%
